units: <cite ref="Shabbat 121b:4">Sabb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ שבארץ מצרים</he> the Egyptian fly (whose sting is dangerous).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:9">Tosef. Sot. V, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 90a">Gitt. 90ᵃ</cite>. Pesik. Zakhor, p. 26ᵇ <he>לז׳ שהוא וכ׳</he> (Amalek resembles) the fly which is greedy for a sore; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְבוּבִים</he>, <he>זְבוּבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:1:3">Y. Sabb. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:4">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:4">XIII</cite>), 4.
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:6">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ של בעלי וכ׳</he> (not <he>זבובי</he>) flies which sucked from those afflicted with gonorrhœa (carrying contagion); a. fr.
